items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: as the late Stanley Dance put it

ctx.x: Did you ever get an assignment to write liner notes for a recording that you didn’t like?

I’m just trying to think. I don’t think so. Well I did do one recently for a Mike Westbrook reissue and I thought the music was pretty — well it left me fairly cold. I think you do as professional a job as you can. I sought to describe it. I sought to highlight what seemed to me to be the aspects that were valuable, and did it as honestly as I could. But of course the liner notes, as the late Stanley Dance put it, is a form of sales promotion, isn’t it? It’s unusual to start a liner and say this is unbelievably…
Speaking of unpleasant, did you ever have an interview that just left you feeling embarrassed or like you really put your foot in it somehow?
